title: PentestChain: A Cost-Aware, MCP-Orchestrated Framework for Automated Penetration Testing with Free-Tier LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.18120v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-driven penetration testing has been demonstrated with premium frontier models such as GPT-4, but the per-engagement token cost makes continuous, automated testing unaffordable for the smaller organisations that need it most. This paper presents PentestChain, a ten-phase automated penetration testing framework that couples a curated, deterministic exploit map with a cost-aware AI cascade-a local Ollama model (qwen2.5-7b) first, then free-tier OpenRouter and Cerebras, with a rule-based fallback that always produces output-and exposes the full pipeline through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with eleven tools. We make three contributions. First, we treat US-dollar cost per engagement as a measured, first-class evaluation metric and show that a 7B-parameter local model, kept off the critical path by a deterministic backbone, sustains end-to-end operation at zero measured paid-API cost. translated_title: PentestChain：一个成本感知的、基于MCP编排的、使用免费层级大语言模型的自动化渗透测试框架
translated_abstract: AI驱动的渗透测试已经在GPT-4等高端前沿模型上得到验证，但每次渗透测试任务的token成本使得持续、自动化的测试对于最需要它的小型组织来说难以承受。本文提出了PentestChain，一个十阶段的自动化渗透测试框架，它将精心策划的确定性漏洞利用图谱与成本感知的AI级联相结合——优先使用本地Ollama模型，然后是免费层级的OpenRouter和Cerebras，并配有基于规则的回退机制以确保始终产生输出——并通过一个包含十一个工具的模型上下文协议服务器暴露完整的流水线。我们做出了三项贡献。第一，我们将每次渗透测试任务的美元成本作为可测量的一等评估指标，并证明了一个7B参数的本地模型（通过确定性骨干网络使其远离关键路径）可以在零测量付费API成本下维持端到端运行。第二，我们分析了攻击面……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出PentestChain框架，通过确定性漏洞利用骨干网络结合成本感知的AI级联（本地7B小模型加免费API优先），实现了零付费API成本的十阶段自动化渗透测试，并将美元成本确立为一等评估指标。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PentestChain, a ten-phase automated penetration testing framework that achieves zero paid-API cost by combining a deterministic exploit backbone with a cost-aware AI cascade prioritizing local 7B and free-tier LLMs, establishing dollar cost as a first-class evaluation metric.
